document.abstract: This article gives an overview of bi-directional total immersion printing, now accepted as the normal method of producing high-quality answer prints, internegatives, CRIs, television transmission prints, and prints from damaged negatives. It describes a new bi-directional printer introduced by Hollywood Film Co., as well as a new high-speed servo light valve developed for use with the printer.
